result.content: The oldest goalscorer in a football (soccer) UEFA European Championships is Luka Modrić (Croatia, b. 9 September 1985), aged 38 years 289 days for Croatia against Italy in Leipzig, Germany, on 24 June 2024. Modric, who is 38 years, 289 days old, claimed the opening goal on a rebound in the 55th minute, within a minute of having a penalty saved by Italy goalkeeper [Gianluigi Donnarumma](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/gianluigi-donnarumma-player).
